responsibility: This header declares the generic default hook functions implemented in hooks.cc. It serves as the common catalog of reusable no-op, constant-returning, null-returning, and identity hook entry points that are referenced by target, language, and host hook initializer macros, so those hook tables can be defined with complete type-correct defaults without duplicating boilerplate implementations.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the declaration-only catalog of reusable generic hook entry points, whereas gcc/hooks.cc contains the actual default implementations that target, language, and host hook tables use.
